pages.title: A Horn for the Road
pages.text: Right-click your dragon with a Dragon Horn to store it; use the filled horn on the ground to release it. Form, equipment, and knowledge stay.

pages.title: Moving an Injured Dragon
pages.text: A severely injured companion cannot enter a horn, but a matching summoning crystal can still bind and summon it.$(br2)Find a safe place, feed it, and wait until it is fully healed before giving a new command.

pages.title: Old Dragon Remains
pages.text: The remains of dragons that died on an older journey are still remains; the new care methods cannot wake them.$(br2)If your companion is severely injured, read $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)Wounds and Stone$(/l). For the difference between injury and death, see $(l:dragonmaid:care/execution)The Final Choice$(/l).
